class.name: DirectionalBulletsData2D
class.description: Ensure that the [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.transforms] and [member all_bullet_speed_data] are set, otherwise spawning fails with an error and no bullets are created (an empty speed array fails; a short array falls back to its first entry for all bullets). Check [MultiMeshBulletsData2D]'s documentation for the rest of the properties.

members.member: If enabled, the bullets will adjust their direction when rotating, instead of only spinning in place.

Per-bullet curves applied at spawn time (and on pool reuse). Same fallback rule as [member all_bullet_speed_data]: empty disables the feature, matching size means per bullet, otherwise the first entry drives all bullets. Null entries are skipped per bullet. Shared curves still win ties per tick.
Per-bullet face flags for [member all_bullet_movement_pattern_paths]. Matching size means per bullet, otherwise the shared [member shared_movement_pattern_face_movement_direction] flag drives.

Per-bullet paths to [Path2D] nodes applied at spawn time (and on pool reuse), same fallback rule as above. Each path's curve is extracted when the volley spawns. Empty or bad entries are skipped per bullet. A set shared pattern takes precedence while active.
Per-bullet repeat flags for [member all_bullet_movement_pattern_paths]. Matching size means per bullet, otherwise the shared [member shared_movement_pattern_repeat] flag drives.

[b]MANDATORY[/b] You can provide [BulletSpeedData2D] for every single bullet - meaning that it should contain the same amount of data as the [member MultiMeshBulletsData2D.transforms].
Warning: If you provide less [BulletSpeedData2D] than the amount of bullets (same as amount of transforms), ALL bullets will use only the first provided speed data. Note: [BulletSpeedData2D] has a helper static method that you can use to generate random speed data - [method BulletSpeedData2D.generate_random_data()].

Per-bullet wobble applied at spawn time (and on pool reuse). Same fallback rule as [member all_bullet_speed_data]: empty disables the feature, matching size means per bullet, otherwise the first entry drives all bullets. Null and disabled entries are skipped per bullet.
Per-bullet queue: pop the front target when the owning bullet reaches it. Pooled reuse re-seeds this from the spawn data, so direct [BulletFactory2D] spawns keep it without a spawner.

Constant acceleration in px/s^2 fanning out to every bullet each tick (2D sideview arcs, tower-defense shells). (0, 0) disables — top-down default. Must stay finite. Per-bullet [member all_bullet_gravity] overrides per slot when provided.

Per-bullet gravity vectors applied at spawn time (and on pool reuse). Same fallback rule as [member all_bullet_speed_data]: empty uses [member gravity] for all bullets, 1 entry fans out, matching size maps per bullet. Non-finite entries fail open to zero for that slot.
Seconds of straight flight before gravity starts integrating (shells that glide first, then drop). 0 falls immediately.
Seconds of falling before gravity stops integrating (shells that drop, then glide on with frozen fall speed). 0 = infinite.
Seconds of straight flight before homing steering starts (classic aimed-then-homing). 0 steers immediately.

Distance in pixels at which a bullet counts as having reached its target (drives the reached signal and auto-pop). Tested against the final steered position, so locked orbiting bullets test their orbit motion.
Seconds of steering before bullets fly straight (lets fast players escape). 0 = infinite.
Steering pauses while the bullet is farther than this from its target. 0 = unlimited.
Shared homing turn agility (0 snaps instantly). Pooled reuse re-seeds this from the spawn data. Setting any per-bullet smoothing on the live volley switches it to per-bullet mode.
Whether homing steers the bullet facing. Leave off when a movement pattern, rotation data, or orbiting texture mode already owns the facing, otherwise homing steers nothing visible.
Seconds between homing target position refreshes (0 refreshes every tick). Larger values make rings lag and step on moving targets; keep 0 for bodyguard rings.
Linear drag trimming speed each tick (speed -= speed * drag * delta). 0 disables. Must be finite and >= 0.
Shared curves applied to every bullet at spawn time (and on pool reuse). Tick precedence is unchanged: shared channels win ties, per-bullet curves fill gaps, plain speed data covers the rest.

Shared rotation applied to every bullet at spawn time (and on pool reuse), taking precedence over per-bullet rotation data when set. Null (default) disables the feature and the rotation array drives instead.

Shared speed applied to every bullet at spawn time (and on pool reuse), taking precedence over [member all_bullet_speed_data] when set. Null (default) disables the feature and the array drives instead. Note: shared movement-speed curves still outrank it per tick.

Shared sine/cosine wobble applied to every bullet at spawn time (and on pool reuse), taking precedence over [member all_bullet_wobble_data] when set and enabled. Phase fans out per bullet so one resource makes snakes and petals; pick Sine vs Cosine on the resource's waveform. Null (default) disables the feature and the array drives instead.
Shared queue: one deferred pop when any bullet reaches the front target. Locked orbit rings follow the lock policy on the new front instead of holding a stale center.
Whether the shared movement pattern rotates bullets to face their direction of travel.

Path to a [Path2D] in the scene tree whose curve is applied as the movement pattern of every bullet at spawn time (and on pool reuse). Resolved relative to the [BulletFactory2D] with a scene-root fallback; absolute paths always work. Empty (default) disables the feature.
Whether the shared movement pattern repeats instead of stopping at the end of the curve.
